parameters.content:
## P2.3C - Approved metadata publisher

Reads `image_registry` and writes Qdrant only when `REVIEW_STATUS=APPROVED`.

- Final columns override `AI_*`; blank final fields fall back to AI suggestions.
- `PENDING`/`STALE`/`REJECTED` are held and do not change the last published point.
- Only `ACTIVE=FALSE` deletes an existing point.
- Publication acknowledgement is written to AN:AO.
- No Gemini metadata classification exists in this workflow.
- Existing workflow ID is preserved for the shard helper: `P23QDRANTLANA001`.
- Keep inactive; launch through the managed helper only.

- Batch cap: 300 points/shard. Duplicate point IDs are collapsed before selection; existing identical content hashes are skipped. Vertex 429 responses retry up to 5 times.

- Daily production mode: 01:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, one shard, maximum 50 changed points per run. Hash calculation is unchanged.
### Memory/CPU optimization 2026-07-21
- Raw Base64 exists only in Build Raw Base64; Vertex references that node directly.
- Cutout Base64 exists only in Build Cutout Base64; Vertex references that node directly.
- Clamp/rate/vector intermediate nodes no longer carry Base64.
- Redundant Finalize vector-copy node removed.
- CLI shard logs keep stderr only; backlog defaults to 2 shards, daily remains 1 × 50.
